summary: Complaints centre on the Aligarh-Moradabad highway land route, poor village roads, sugarcane and fertiliser problems and weak government school education, while residents mainly appreciate law and order and electricity.

positives.english: Law and order has improved compared to earlier
positives.hindi: कानून व्यवस्था पहले से बेहतर है
positives.basis: Amar Ujala Asmoli constituency report: several residents said law and order has improved; Jamshed Ansari praised the Yogi government's law and order

positives.english: Electricity supply has improved since the current government came to power
positives.hindi: बिजली पहले से ठीक मिलने लगी है
positives.basis: Amar Ujala Asmoli constituency report: one resident said electricity supply has improved since the BJP government came to power; Naseer praised the electricity system

positives.english: Government work is going well, says a local resident
positives.hindi: सरकार का काम ठीक चल रहा है
positives.basis: Amar Ujala Asmoli constituency report: Shakeel Ahmad said things are working well and all work is going well; Anil Kumar Sharma praised the government's working style

positives.english: Inference: district-level development projects have been inaugurated in Sambhal
positives.hindi: *संभल में कई विकास कार्यों का लोकार्पण हुआ है
positives.basis: Inference: Patrika (6 Aug 2025) reported a planned programme of 221 projects in Sambhal district including 113 inaugurations; the article does not name Asmoli and does not confirm delivery in Asmoli AC

positives.english: Inference: an order was given to build an access road to the Arogya Mandir at Saindhari
positives.hindi: *आरोग्य मंदिर तक सड़क बनाने का आदेश हुआ है
positives.basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (7 Oct 2026) reports the PWD special secretary ordered an immediate road to be built at Saindhari; it is an order, not a completed road, and Asmoli AC membership of Saindhari is unconfirmed

negatives.english: Fear of losing homes and schools in 14 villages due to the Aligarh-Moradabad highway route
negatives.hindi: अलीगढ़-मुरादाबाद हाईवे से 14 गांवों के घर और स्कूल उजड़ने का डर
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (9 Oct 2026): MLA Pinki Yadav and MP Dharmendra Yadav met Gadkari; the article cites 14 villages in Asmoli assembly constituency at risk of displacement of homes, businesses and schools; they asked for a route change and market-value land purchase

negatives.english: Village roads are in very poor condition
negatives.hindi: गांव की सड़कें बहुत खराब हैं
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala Asmoli constituency report: residents said road conditions are poor; roads named as the biggest issue by Yakub; village not named in the article

negatives.english: Sugar prices went up but sugarcane price did not rise
negatives.hindi: चीनी के दाम बढ़े पर गन्ने का दाम नहीं बढ़ा
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala Asmoli constituency report: farmers said sugar prices rose but cane prices did not increase; quoted as farmers' statement

negatives.english: No road to the Arogya Mandir at Saindhari (Asmoli block); AC membership unconfirmed
negatives.hindi: सैंधरी में आरोग्य मंदिर तक सड़क ही नहीं है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (7 Oct 2026): PWD special secretary inspection found no road for the Saindhari Arogya Mandir; article mentions Asmoli block (असमोली ब्लॉक क्षेत्र), not the constituency; AC membership unconfirmed

negatives.english: No concrete steps taken on education in our area; government school education is weak
negatives.hindi: हमारे इलाके में शिक्षा पर कोई ठोस कदम नहीं उठे
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala Asmoli constituency report: Deepak said no concrete steps have been taken on education in the area; Sumit Rawat raised education in government schools

notes: AC identity confirmed: No. 32 Asmoli, reserved None, district Sambhal (Wikipedia list page; Asmoli AC infobox). Wikipedia does not give an AC extent (tehsils/blocks); Wikipedia Asmoli village page says it is in Sambhal Tehsil. Whether Asmoli block villages such as Saindhari, Madala, Shahbajpur are inside the AC is unconfirmed. Positives 4 and 5 are inferences (district-level planned projects; an order, not a completed road) and are weak; no sourced delivered Asmoli-specific project was found. Positive 2 (electricity) rests on one resident's remark. Negatives 2, 3 and 5 are from the 4 Sep 2026 Amar Ujala Asmoli constituency article, which does not name villages; counted as AC-level. Searches with no Asmoli-specific results: hepatitis/contaminated groundwater (2024 claim found only in a secondary Amar Ujala summary, not opened, so not used), sugarcane mill dues, stray cattle, village road inauguration, substation power supply. Electoral data (vote shares, voter-roll deletions and cut-off comparisons) excluded per brief. Field check suggested: the highway route and land compensation at circle rates; Saindhari road; sugarcane dues from the nearest mill.
